decisions: No reference GLB is embedded or shipped in V003.
The runtime gun is a repository-owned semantic reconstruction.
The bore center and all muzzle effects share one muzzle_socket transform.
Ground, vehicle, naval and display mounts are rejected.
The lightweight yoke shown is an unresolved aircraft-interface study, not a B-24 approved station mount.
Historical ammunition colors follow the 1944 manual; non-historical paint schemes are marked visualization-only.
